title: ADI Forge Confidentiality and Intellectual Property
body:
These terms apply to your work on ADI Forge, operated by ADI-Labs ("we", "us"), together with the ADI Forge Contributor Terms.

1. Confidential information
"Confidential information" means anything you see or receive through ADI Forge that is not public, including task templates, task content, review comments, policies, rubrics, project details, platform features and information about other contributors or our clients.

2. Your obligations
You will:
- use confidential information only to carry out tasks assigned to you;
- not share, publish, copy or discuss it with anyone outside ADI Forge, including on social media, forums or AI tools outside the platform;
- not download, screenshot or keep copies except where the platform allows it for your assigned work;
- keep your account secure and tell us straight away at admin@adi-labs.ai if you believe confidential information has been exposed.

3. Exceptions
These obligations do not apply to information that is already public through no fault of yours, that you already lawfully knew, or that you must disclose by law (in which case, tell us first where the law allows).

4. Your work
You assign to ADI-Labs all rights, including copyright and other intellectual property rights, in the tasks, answers, reviews, comments and other material you create for ADI Forge ("Work"), from the moment it is created. Where an assignment is not possible, you grant ADI-Labs an exclusive, perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify, combine and commercialise the Work. You waive any moral rights in the Work to the extent the law allows.

5. Your own material
Do not include in your Work any material you do not have the right to give us, including material owned by a current or past employer or client. You keep ownership of your general skills and knowledge.

6. Return and deletion
When you stop taking part, or when we ask, stop using confidential information and delete any copies you hold.

7. Duration
These obligations continue after you stop taking part on ADI Forge.

Questions: admin@adi-labs.ai

By selecting "I accept", you confirm you have read and agree to these terms.
